linkedin.summary:
Asset management professional, who enjoys leading teams and building businesses.  Proud daughter of an Indian diplomat, global citizen, and child of change.  Writer, storyteller, TEDx and Josh Talks speaker, finding magic in words.

I’m a girl on a mission, with wings of fire!  And I share my little stories along this journey on LinkedIn… 

The best way to connect with me is my official email ID, radhika.gupta@edelweissmf.com.  LinkedIn direct messages may be seen more sporadically.

positions.title: Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer
positions.description: MD and CEO of one of India’s fastest growing asset management companies.  We manage approx 1.7 Lakh crores in AUM (USD 18 billion) and are one of India’s most innovative asset managers with many firsts to our credit.  Overseeing investments, sales and marketing, compliance, technology and operations.  Building a high quality business and team, step by step, day by day!

positions.title: Business Head
positions.description: Grew the business from 150 crores at acquisition to over 2000 crores in a little over 2 years, and into India's most dominant player in the listed alternatives space.  Lead the acquisition of Ambit Alpha Fund in 2016 and the integration of JPMorgan into Edelweiss AMC through 2016.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: Co-founder of one of India's first alternative investment boutiques offering differentiated strategies on the PMS and AIF platforms.  The first fund to receive a Category III AIF license and a pioneer in liquid alternatives.  Forefront was acquired by Edelweiss Financial Services, in 2014 and is currently Edelweiss Multi-Strategy Funds.

positions.title: Portfolio Manager
positions.description: Developed and traded developed and emerging equities, interest rates, inflation and currency strategies at large quantitative global macro hedge fund.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description: Business analyst with experience on strategy, marketing, and organizational cases across the technology, pharmaceutical, and retail sectors.

positions.title: Program Manager Intern
positions.description: Program Manager Intern over two summers (2003, 2004) for Microsoft Office (Graphics and Presentations - Powerpoint and Visio).  Responsible for conceptualizing and designing new features in Office products.

latestIgtvVideos.caption:
I thought pregnancy meant countless limitations.  5.5 months (and reading many stories of women leaders) later, I realised this was just a bias in my mind.  This Women’s Day, we at Edelweiss MF challenge you to #BreakTheBias in your minds…when you do, you are limitless :)

P.S.  Speaking of breaking biases, my team convinced me to shoot this video, despite me saying, “I look like a ball!“. One more internal bias, broken!

A mutual fund isn’t just schemes, NAVs and AUM.  Our best assets are our people.  Meet the people who manage your money, the superstars who are front and center here, in a different avatar.  From us to you, have a great Diwali week.

Democratising wealth: How women can invest

•	Radhika Gupta, MD & CEO, Edelweiss Mutual Fund

Money should not be complicated. And investing should not feel out of reach. 💰📈

At the India Today Woman Summit 2026, Radhika Gupta, MD & CEO, Edelweiss Mutual Fund, broke down the conversation around wealth creation and why more women need to take charge of their financial future.

From taking the first steps towards investing to building long-term wealth, the session explored how women can move from earning and saving to investing with confidence and purpose.

Because financial independence is not just about making money—it’s about making your money work for you.

This conversation offers valuable lessons for investors looking to build and manage their portfolios effectively.
